## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

Describe the proposed change. Be specific about user-facing behavior
and the API surface (if any).

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why are they worse?

## Success criteria

How will we know this is done? Include testable acceptance criteria.

## Out of scope

Anything that should be deferred to a follow-up issue.
